_about: Example-gene slots of the main figures. mode=pin keeps the gene the current manuscript names (it must still be eligible in the new bundle, otherwise the receipt reports example_ineligible and nothing old is drawn); mode=rank takes rank 1 of the statistics-side eligible list. Switching a slot to rank can change the gene shown, its caption and the Results text.

dual_reference_mouse.rank_rule: candidate_screen/example_selection role=dual_reference species=mouse rank 1 (3D); dual_reference_candidates by descending minimum_abs_effect (3C)

homolog_example.rank_rule: follows dual_reference_mouse: the human ortholog pair with qualified P-S and P-M homologous sites

partial_retention_mouse.rank_rule: candidate_screen/example_selection role=partial_retention species=mouse rank 1; first factor with a recurrent strict changed and a retained site
partial_retention_mouse.label: GGCAGTG, miR-34/449 seed

low_shift.rank_rule: candidate_screen/example_selection role=low_shift_interval, restricted to the final low_shift_attrition stage (both |ΔDWUI| < .01); lowest rank
